Our clients

About

Helping people find their way since ’08.

We were among the first to introduce digital wayfinding through animated pathing, and we’re now one of the largest providers of kiosks, mobile and web platforms globally. Our teams manage everything from analysis and UX design to manufacturing, software, installation and support.

Support

Performance you can count on.

Comprehensive software and hardware support, with unlimited phone, email and on-site help whenever you need it.

🤝

Personalised service

You’re guided through your project and given a personal contact who supports you into the future. We’re invested in your solution’s success.

Global support network

Twenty years of technical support experience with worldwide coverage and intimate market knowledge, in many languages, from downtown Shanghai to a small country town.
